captionStarter: Ravens 34-31 over Cowboys in Rio. Tyler Loop hit a 56-yarder as time expired.
concept: Split-screen: Cowboys sideline celebrating the game-tying kick / same sideline 7 seconds later watching Tyler Loop's 56-yarder go through
description: The Baltimore Ravens beat the Dallas Cowboys 34-31 in Rio de Janeiro on Tyler Loop's 56-yard field goal as time expired, after Dallas had tied the game with 7 seconds left.
headline: Ravens walk it off in Rio to beat Cowboys 34-31
